content:
Apple has revealed what it calls "the sneakiest crossover of the summer," featuring a partnership between Apple Arcade's *Sneaky Sasquatch* and *Subway Surfers+*, along with a series of stickers for use in the Messages app...

Apple says the crossover kicks off today, with a follow-up update arriving on September 17.

Today, "the sneakiest crossover of the summer" arrives exclusively on Apple Arcade. From now through October 7, *Sneaky Sasquatch* will reimagine the classic world of *Subway Surfers+* with the charm and style of its popular open-world Arcade game. Players can unlock four character costumes and two unique hoverboards, plus explore a brand-new level inspired by Sasquatch Valley, where classic coins are swapped for raccoon coins and security guards don park ranger outfits to keep up their patrols. But the sneakiness doesn't end there — fans have even more to look forward to, as a major update is set to drop on September 17. Apple Arcade Senior Director Alex Rofman said: "*Sneaky Sasquatch* is one of the most popular games on Apple Arcade, and it has had one of the most passionate player communities since launch. This exclusive crossover with *Subway Surfers+*, along with the new birdwatching update, are just the latest ways players can continue to enjoy *Sneaky Sasquatch*, with plenty more exciting updates rolling out in the coming months."

As for next month's update, players can look forward to over 30 species of birds appearing, waiting to be captured on camera.

You can also download *Sneaky Sasquatch* stickers to use in iMessage.
